items: Added automatic smooth transition from the Front tab to the next reading tab (Language or Source) when scrolling to the bottom.
Added scroll-based Table of Contents (TOC) highlighting to automatically activate the current chapter and subchapter headings while reading in Language and Source tabs.
Enhanced Parallel and Dual view mode TOC tracking using post position matching so active subchapters remain highlighted throughout the entire scroll.
Updated TOC chapter title resolution in Language tab (none view) to support Chinese, English, and dual Chinese-English formats.
Unified target language resolution across both Parallel and Dual view modes using Language 1.
Removed hover text color changes on TOC subchapter items to keep text color consistent.
Applied active highlight color to the second language title in TOC subchapter items.
Removed uppercase language badges above post titles in LanguageTab for a cleaner reading layout.
Fixed a ReferenceError in ChapterViewPage caused by accessing isSingleLanguageBook before initialization.
Enhanced Table of Contents (TOC) with dynamic multi-language synchronization across None, Parallel, and Dual view modes.
Added primary language priority (Language 1 before Language 2) in TOC titles for Parallel and Dual reading modes.
Configured default initial reading view to Front tab with English language pre-selected in TOC and reader options.
Integrated immediate reading progress persistence hook supporting new, registered, and existing logged-in users.
Removed redundant serial number indicators from Table of Contents for cleaner presentation.
Added automatic view mode and language tab visibility toggle for single-language books (routing directly to Source).
Streamlined language dropdown interactions in ChapterView to activate and display chosen language seamlessly.
Enhanced TOC chapter title navigation when switching from Front tab directly into target chapter sections.
